guidances.libelle: charge liée aux effectifs et à la consolidation/fermeture d'agences
guidances.citation: Accordingly, we plan to reduce our workforce and consolidate or close branches in the fourth quarter and incur a corresponding charge to Adjusted EBITDA of approximately $6 million to $8 million.
With all these factors in mind, we expect Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal year 2026 to be in the range of $425 million to $440 million.
